expectations.text: All five beats (Hook, Story, Turn, Takeaway, Closer) are present in exact order with 45s timing labels (0-3s, 3-20s, 20-32s, 32-42s, 42-45s)
Spoken word count (excluding beat labels) is within 100-120 words
Hook is one striking opening sentence with no greeting or setup
Takeaway includes exactly one practical action (leave laptop at desk and bring one index card to next internal meeting)
Output contains only the voiceover script with no visual/style/motion direction and no introduction or closing notes
No invented facts, team sizes, durations, or percentages beyond the user's input
expectations.evidence: Embellished 'under the table' beyond prompt's 'multitasking on Slack'

expectations.text: Reads naturally aloud with zero em/en dashes, AI buzzwords, rule-of-three padding, or 'not X, it's Y' contrast cliches

errors: Found AI-sounding buzzword 'quietly'; replace with plain spoken English.
